question.text: Category III AIFs register with SEBI under which form?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per the workbook (pp.91-92), applications seeking registration as a Category III AIF are made to SEBI in Form A, accompanied by a non-refundable application fee. The Trap: Form B is the format in which the SEBI Registration Certificate is issued (p.106), not the application form. Forms C and Z are not used here. Note: Remember the pair — Form A for application and Form B for the registration certificate.
